plugins.name: foundationdb-dotnet-skills
plugins.description: Agent Skills for the FoundationDB .NET client: keys & layers, transactions, advanced/distributed layers, the Slice binary toolkit, the CrystalJson stack and its source generator, running/connecting (Aspire hosting & client, the native client), outbound HTTP with BetterHttpClient (DI policy bundles, TLS, HttpWebRequest migration), and writing/diagnosing multi-node integration tests (the SnowBank distributed-test framework & its unified journal), plus argument guards and assertions with Contract (Contract.NotNull / Positive / Debug.Requires).
